calls.summary: Maria Delgado called to start year-round service and asked specifically about mosquito coverage for her backyard. Rosey walked her through the Premium Plan, confirmed the roughly every 30 days warm-season schedule, and explained the Aptive Promise re-service guarantee. Maria booked a next-day Service Appointment and confirmed her address.

James Holloway requested a quote for the Pro Plan after spotting rodent activity in his garage and garden. Lila explained the indoor and outdoor rodent control plus the six-visit minimum and the photo-based Pest Diagnostic report. James accepted the quote and scheduled his first visit.

Angela Foster called to review her Pest Diagnostic report after a recent ants treatment and wanted to understand the technician notes. Oscar explained the perimeter and interior work, the photos, and the recommended next steps. Angela was reassured and kept her existing plan without booking anything new.

Priya Natarajan called as a first-time homeowner wanting to schedule her initial service and learn her options. Mary collected her name, address, home size, and pest concerns, then built a quote for the Basic Plan covering 30 common pests over four yearly visits. Priya booked her first Service Appointment and provided contact details for the Pest Diagnostic report.

Derek Mason wanted the only plan that includes mosquito control before his family's summer gatherings. Mike confirmed the Premium Plan details and the seasonal treatment cadence, then checked local branch availability. Derek scheduled a Service Appointment for the following week.

Susan Whitfield called with a billing question about a treatment charge she did not expect on her statement. Jennifer reviewed the account, explained the per-visit pricing tied to her Pro Plan, and noted no hidden fees under the Aptive Promise. Susan understood the charge but did not book any new service.

Carlos Rivera reported mice in his attic and asked about standalone rodent control versus a full plan. Lee explained that indoor and outdoor rodent control is included with the Pro Plan and set expectations for the first visit. Carlos scheduled a Service Appointment for the inspection.

Nancy Boone called because ants returned two weeks after her last treatment and she was frustrated. Sue confirmed the re-service guarantee at no additional cost and arranged a technician revisit under the Aptive Promise. Nancy was satisfied with the resolution but did not add a new plan.

Tyler Grant asked for a quote comparing the Basic and Pro Plans for a home with heavy garden activity. Rose explained the garden-pest coverage including snails and aphids on the Pro Plan and priced out both options. Tyler decided to move forward and booked his first Service Appointment.

Rebecca Lin called to cancel her plan because she is selling her house and moving out of the area. Oscar confirmed there were no cancellation penalties and processed the request after reviewing her account. No further service was scheduled.

Frank Abernathy disputed a billing charge he believed was a duplicate for one visit. Jennifer researched the account and found a timing overlap between two statements, then opened a correction request. Frank remained irritated and ended the call without booking anything.

Olivia Brooks called about wasp and hornet nests near her front door and wanted help quickly. Lila explained the nest knockdown and barrier treatment included with standard plans and checked next-day availability. Olivia scheduled a Service Appointment despite a long hold earlier in the call.

Gregory Pane called to cancel after being unhappy with a missed visit window. Lee apologized, explained the scheduling issue, and offered to reschedule under the guarantee. Gregory declined and proceeded with the cancellation.

Henry Caldwell called after hours about a technician who did not show for his scheduled treatment and the call rolled to voicemail. He left a message asking for a callback and an updated arrival time. No agent handled the call live and nothing was scheduled.

Diane Mercer called with a complaint that her mosquito problem persisted after two visits and she felt the service was not working. Sue listened, documented the concern, and offered a priority revisit under the Aptive Promise. Diane stayed upset and did not accept a new appointment on the call.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: Yes. The caller has active ant and spider problems around the exterior and interior of their home. They need immediate relief and ongoing protection.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects professional treatment with guaranteed results and wants to schedule their first service visit as soon as possible, ideally within the next week.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: Marcus should have captured the caller's email address for the Pest Diagnostic reports and set clearer expectations about what to expect during the ProAct Inspection, including approximate visit duration and post-visit photo documentation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Aptive Pest Control. This is Marcus speaking. May I have your name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, yes. My name is Jennifer Patterson. We just moved into our new home here in Scottsdale about two weeks ago and we're already seeing ants around the kitchen and spiders on the patio.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Jennifer, welcome to Scottsdale and congratulations on your new home. I'm sorry to hear you're already dealing with pest activity. We can definitely help with that. Can I confirm your ZIP code is 85251?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Actually, it's 85255. We're closer to the north side near Shea Boulevard.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for that. 85255 is absolutely in our service area. So you mentioned ants in the kitchen and spiders on the patio. Are there any other pests you've noticed or are concerned about?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Just those two right now. The ants seem to be coming in from outside, maybe around the door frame. I've tried some sprays but nothing seems to stick.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand the frustration. Our ProAct Inspection will identify exactly where those ants are entering and we'll apply a barrier treatment to stop them at the source. That's something we do at every visit. For your situation, I'd recommend our Pro Plan. It's our most popular plan with service visits six times per year. Can I get the best phone number to reach you?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Jennifer. Now let me get you scheduled. Our next available appointment in your area is this Friday, October 26th at 2 PM. Does that work for you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Friday works perfectly. That's just a few days away, which is great.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. So Jennifer Patterson, 85255, Friday October 26th at 2 PM for your Pro Plan service. A technician will arrive, perform our ProAct Inspection, treat the ant entry points and the spider areas with our barrier treatment, and you'll receive a detailed report after. We're so confident in our work that if any pests return, we'll retreat at no charge. That's the Aptive Promise. Is there anything else I can help clarify?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No, that sounds great, Marcus. I'm really looking forward to getting this handled.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Thank you for choosing Aptive, Jennifer. We'll see you Friday at 2 PM. Have a wonderful day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Jennifer Patterson called from her new Scottsdale home to report active ant and spider pest problems. Marcus qualified her needs, confirmed her service area ZIP code 85255, and recommended the Pro Plan with six annual service visits based on her pest activity. He successfully captured her full name and phone number and scheduled her first appointment for Friday, October 26th at 2 PM. However, Marcus did not collect her email address for future Pest Diagnostic reports and did not fully set expectations for the first visit duration and inspection process.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, solid call structure and great job capturing the key details and moving Jennifer to the appointment. Two coaching notes: First, make sure you always ask for the email address. That's critical for delivering her post-visit Pest Diagnostic report with photos and notes. Second, take 10 extra seconds at the close to set clear expectations about what Friday's visit will look like, such as mentioning that the ProAct Inspection takes about 20 to 30 minutes and she'll receive the detailed report via email that same day. These small touches improve confidence and reduce no-shows.

qaPairs.question: How much does Aptive pest control cost?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing is customized to your home, pests, and plan, so the best way to get an accurate number is a quick consultation with a local specialist. I can help you build a plan and set that up today.

qaPairs.question: What plans do you offer?
qaPairs.answer: We offer three recurring plans: Basic, Pro, and our most comprehensive Premium plan that is the only one including mosquito control. I can help you compare them and book your first visit.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer mosquito control?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, mosquito control is included with our Premium plan and is available as a seasonal treatment. I can set up a consultation to get you started.

qaPairs.question: How often do you come out?
qaPairs.answer: Basic is serviced at least 4 times per year, Pro at least 6 times, and Premium roughly every 30 days in warmer months and every 60 days in cooler months. Would you like me to schedule your first visit?

qaPairs.question: Is there a guarantee?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, the Aptive Promise means no hidden fees and if pests come back, so do we at no extra cost. I can help you book a visit to get protected.

qaPairs.question: Do you treat rodents?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, indoor and outdoor rodent control covering mice and rats is included with our Pro and Premium plans. Let's confirm your ZIP and get you scheduled.

qaPairs.question: Can you get rid of ants in my house?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our ant control includes perimeter and interior treatment targeting common ant species, trails, and entry points, and it is included in our plans. I can book a technician to come take a look.

qaPairs.question: Do you handle wasp and hornet nests?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our stinging pest service includes nest knockdown, barrier treatment, and leave-behind devices for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets. I can get a specialist out to you, what day works?

qaPairs.question: What pests does the Basic plan cover?
qaPairs.answer: The Basic plan protects against 30 common pests including the most common insects and indoor rodents, serviced at least 4 times a year. I can help you start a plan today.

qaPairs.question: What is the ProAct Inspection?
qaPairs.answer: The ProAct Inspection reviews your service history, fully inspects your property, and tailors treatment at every visit, with a photo and notes report sent to your phone. Would you like to schedule your first inspection?

qaPairs.question: Do you offer same day or next day service?
qaPairs.answer: We offer fast, often next-day service through your local branch depending on availability. Share your ZIP and I'll check openings for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you treat spiders?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, spider control includes de-webbing and barrier treatment around eaves, corners, and entryways, and it is included in our plans. I can book a visit for you.

qaPairs.question: Can I get just one treatment instead of a plan?
qaPairs.answer: Our plans are designed as year-round protection with recurring visits, which is what makes the Aptive Promise possible. I can walk you through the options and set up a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you treat fleas and ticks?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, both flea control and tick control for your yard and perimeter are included in our plans. Let's get a specialist scheduled to assess your property.

qaPairs.question: What is the most popular plan?
qaPairs.answer: The Pro plan is our most popular, built for higher pest activity, gardens, and rodent concerns with at least 6 visits a year. I can help you get started with Pro.

qaPairs.question: Do you treat cockroaches?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we handle cockroaches, with German roaches available as an add-on to the Premium plan. I can set up a visit to get them treated.

qaPairs.question: Will the treatment be safe around my kids and pets?
qaPairs.answer: Our technicians tailor treatments to your home and follow product guidelines for responsible application. A local specialist can review the details with you during your visit, which I can book now.

qaPairs.question: Do you service my area?
qaPairs.answer: We serve many residential areas through local branches, so if you share your ZIP code I can confirm availability and find you an appointment.

qaPairs.question: What do I get after each visit?
qaPairs.answer: After every visit you receive a Pest Diagnostic report with notes, photos, and recommended next steps sent directly to your phone. I can schedule your first visit whenever you're ready.

qaPairs.question: How do I get a quote?
qaPairs.answer: The fastest way is to build a plan and have a quick consultation with a local specialist for an exact quote. Share your ZIP and the pests you're seeing and I'll get that started.

convo.text: Hi there, thanks for calling Aptive Pest Control. I see you've been checking out our Premium Plan. Are you looking to get mosquito control set up for your property in Santa Barbara?
Yeah, we just moved to the area and we've got a pretty big backyard. The mosquitoes have been really bad, especially in the evenings. We want year-round protection if possible.

Perfect. The Premium Plan is actually our most comprehensive option and it's the only one that includes full mosquito control with seasonal treatments. We also do a ProAct Inspection at every visit to tailor the treatment to your specific property. How many times per year were you thinking about service visits?

I like that it's seasonal. In summer we're here pretty much every weekend, so regular visits make sense. We also want to make sure we're covered for ticks and fleas since we have a dog. Does the Premium Plan cover all of that?

Absolutely. The Premium Plan includes indoor and outdoor rodent control, tick and flea treatments, and all common household pests, plus that mosquito coverage. We'll send you a Pest Diagnostic report with photos and notes after every visit, and of course we back everything with the Aptive Promise, so if pests come back, we come back at no extra cost. I'm going to connect you with our local Santa Barbara team to schedule your first ProAct Inspection and build out a quote customized for your property.
